platform.description: The platform of the environment; null until known.

runtime.description: The .NET RID of the environment; null until known.

kind.description: "mcmod" for a package whose manifest is a manifest.json. Other kinds record packages of formats the protocol does not define; an implementation that does not know a kind must not install, uninstall or update that package.

explicit.description: Whether a request named the package (as opposed to a dependency).

chain.description: The sources followed to reach the package. The first is what an update requests again.

ref.description: The source, including its ref (e.g. "github.com/o/r@branch:main"); the first may also be the file: URI of a local file or directory given in a request.

target.description: The index of the target selected in the meta package reached here; null when a concrete package is reached.

commit.description: For a remote repository: the commit its archive was at.

archive.description: The archive identifier of the package; null when unknown (packages taken over from tooth_lock.json).

files.description: The owned files, workspace-relative and '/'-separated; files under plugins/ are recorded in the mods/ form.

url.description: Where the ZIP file was read from: the https URL it was downloaded from, the file: URI of a local file, or null for a ZIP file inside another archive.

path.description: The directory inside the ZIP file that is the archive of the package, when it is a directory of it.
The path of the archive in the repository; "" for the root.
The absolute path of the directory on the local file system.
